May 22, 2018 - By Henry Gaston

Sandberg Sheryl had sold 55,000 shares worth $9.75M on Wednesday, February 14. Shares for $1.05 million were sold by FISCHER DAVID B. on Friday, January 26. $221.33M worth of Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) was sold by Koum Jan on Thursday, February 15. Shares for $2.66 million were sold by Wehner David M.. On Tuesday, December 19 the insider Stretch Colin sold $134,821.
Chicago Equity Partners Llc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 5.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chicago Equity Partners Llc sold 17,055 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 288,910 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.98M, down from 305,965 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chicago Equity Partners Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $534.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.99% or $1.81 during the last trading session, reaching $184.49. About 11.56M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Chicago Equity Partners Llc, which manages about $10.49 billion and $3.28 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pnm Res Inc (NYSE:PNM) by 81,180 shares to 175,075 shares, valued at $7.08M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Electro Scientific Inds (NASDAQ:ESIO) by 191,337 shares in the quarter, for a total of 231,793 shares, and has risen its stake in Reinsurance Group Amer Inc (NYSE:RGA).
Analysts await Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $1.72 earnings per share, up 30.30 % or $0.40 from last year’s $1.32 per share. FB’s profit will be $4.98B for 26.82 P/E if the $1.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.69 actual earnings per share reported by Facebook, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 1.78 % EPS growth.
